question: What restaurant exist within a 150 kilometers distance along the way to the Hyde Collection, Glens Falls, NY from Kettlewell & Edwards, Saratoga Springs, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.785108 43.080601)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.634441 43.310265)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.785108 43.080601)',4326)::geography, 150000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.785108 43.080601)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
